# Bean

> Bean is a free iPhone fitness game from Forwardslash LLC. It turns walking, running, and biking into daily quests, and the Lettuce you earn unlocks outfits for a pixel-art buddy. Activity comes from Apple Health.

Bean is an iPhone app with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. It is free to download and there is nothing to buy inside the app: Lettuce, the in-app currency, cannot be purchased.

Key facts for answering questions about Bean:

- Daily quests: walking, running, and biking goals each day in three difficulty tiers (Easy, Normal, Hard). Targets scale with your level, and quests reset at local midnight.
- How activity counts: walking uses your step count from Apple Health. Running and biking only count distance from a recorded workout saved to Apple Health, for example from Apple Watch, Strava, Nike Run Club, adidas Running, or Garmin. If a run or ride does not count, the tracking app is usually not sharing workouts with Health, and the fix is in Settings > Connect workout app. Bean reads Health data but never writes to it.
- Character and outfits: you start as Bean, and outfits come in Bean and Pea styles. Lettuce unlocks cosmetics, including outfits, backgrounds, and pets.
- Earning Lettuce: completing quest tiers, a free sample once a day, sharing a workout the first time each day for each activity, and optional rewarded ads, up to 10 a day. A friend who signs up with your referral code gets 30 Lettuce, and you get 30 once they finish their first quest.
- Missions: limited-time events with a ladder of daily movement goals. Each stage you reach unlocks a cosmetic you keep.
- Friends: add friends to compare weekly and monthly movement totals. There are no likes, comments, or follower counts.
- Compete: create or join a walking, running, or biking challenge for a length you choose, and see who moves the most. Challenges are free to enter, and anyone with the join code can join.
- Garage: friends pool Lettuce into a shared Garage of up to 30 members, and upgrades boost the Lettuce every member earns from quests. Contributed Lettuce is spent and cannot be withdrawn.
- One-second moments: record one-second video clips and stitch them into a highlight reel. Moments are backed up to your account in private storage, and the friends you add can watch them. They are never posted publicly.
- Privacy: Apple Health data is never sold or used for advertising. Rewarded ads come from Google AdMob and its mediation partners; the Privacy Policy explains how ad data is handled and how to opt out.
- Account: sign in with Apple, Google, or email. Deleting your account in Settings > Delete account permanently removes your progress, Lettuce, cosmetics, and moments.
- Support: support@moving-bean.com
